company.name: Brightwater Accountancy
company.summary: Brightwater Accountancy is a 28-person accounting and bookkeeping firm in Utrecht. You serve about 400 small businesses with bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts, and payroll. Your team uses Exact, Twinfield, Excel, and a client portal, and spends significant time chasing clients for documents each month.
offerings: Client document collection and portal management
company.customers: Small businesses in and around Utrecht, mainly owner-managed companies and local firms.

roles.title: Bookkeeping Specialist
repetitive_tasks: Enter bank transactions into Exact or Twinfield
Match receipts and invoices to ledger entries
Chase clients for missing documents each month

roles.title: Payroll Administrator
repetitive_tasks: Calculate holiday pay and sick pay
Update employee changes in payroll software

roles.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
repetitive_tasks: Enter client data into Exact or Twinfield

strategy.situation: Brightwater Accountancy is a 28-person firm in Utrecht serving about 400 small businesses with bookkeeping, VAT, annual accounts, and payroll. Your team runs on Exact, Twinfield, Excel, and a client portal, and still chases many clients for documents each month.
strategy.complication: The current way depends on manual email chasing and spreadsheet trackers, which creates deadline risk and pulls senior accountants into routine work. Clients expect faster answers, and any filing error or missed deadline carries compliance and reputation cost.
strategy.governing_thought: Start with three phase 1 agents: client document chasing, bank transaction coding and reconciliation, and routine client question answering, to cut manual admin and free your team for review work.

key_arguments.headline: Monthly document chasing and bank entry eat the most repetitive time
key_arguments.support: Your 11-person bookkeeping team and 3-person client services team carry most of the manual work. Document chasing, transaction coding, and routine client questions repeat for every client, every month. Senior accountants still correct coding and answer questions that follow the same patterns.

key_arguments.headline: Document chasing, transaction coding, and client questions are the best first agents
key_arguments.support: These three tasks are high volume, rule-based, and already supported by Exact, Twinfield, and your portal. They need limited integration and produce visible relief in the first month. Each one has a clear review step, so your team stays in control.

key_arguments.headline: Pilot with one client group, review outputs, then expand agent by agent
key_arguments.support: Start with 30 to 40 clients and a named reviewer for each agent. Measure accuracy, response rates, and hours returned before adding more clients. After the pilot, connect the remaining agents in the same way and train the team on exception handling.

strategy.executive_summary: Brightwater Accountancy is a 28-person firm in Utrecht serving about 400 small businesses with bookkeeping, VAT, annual accounts, and payroll. Your team runs on Exact, Twinfield, Excel, and a client portal, and still chases many clients for documents each month. The current way depends on manual email chasing and spreadsheet trackers, which creates deadline risk and pulls senior accountants into routine work. Clients expect faster answers, and any filing error or missed deadline carries compliance and reputation cost. Start with three phase 1 agents: client document chasing, bank transaction coding and reconciliation, and routine client question answering, to cut manual admin and free your team for review work.

maturity.label: Early
maturity.note: You use Exact, Twinfield and a portal, but most repetitive work is still manual email and Excel. There are no production AI agents today.

opportunities.title: Client documents chased and tracked automatically
opportunities.description: An agent monitors missing document lists in Exact, Twinfield and the portal, sends personalized reminders, and logs replies. It escalates only clients who do not respond after two reminders.
before: Bookkeeper marks missing items in Excel
Coordinator writes reminder emails one by one
Team checks portal and inbox for replies
Bookkeeper updates status in Exact or Twinfield
Lead reviews overdue list at month end
after: Agent reads missing item list from Exact, Twinfield and portal
Agent sends reminder with correct client details and deadline
Agent logs replies and attachments into client record
Human: reviews exceptions and calls difficult clients
Human: confirms complete document set before close

opportunities.title: Bank transactions coded and matched automatically
opportunities.description: An agent reads bank feeds, proposes ledger codes and matches receipts and invoices to transactions. Your bookkeepers approve or correct suggestions in a review queue.
before: Download bank statement from Exact or Twinfield
Open each transaction and choose ledger code
Search email or portal for matching receipt
Attach document and mark transaction reconciled
Senior accountant reviews coding errors later
after: Agent pulls bank feed and open invoices
Agent proposes ledger code and match with confidence score
Agent attaches source document to transaction
Human: approves or corrects suggested coding
Human: reviews exceptions and signs off reconciliation

opportunities.title: Routine client questions answered from approved templates
opportunities.description: An agent answers common portal and accounting questions using your approved FAQ and client records, and routes anything unusual to a senior accountant. Every answer is logged for review.
before: Client sends question by portal or email
Coordinator searches old emails for answer
Coordinator asks senior accountant if unsure
Senior accountant writes reply from scratch
Coordinator copies reply into portal and closes ticket
after: Agent reads question and client context in portal
Agent drafts answer from approved FAQ and prior replies
Agent sends routine answers with a review link
Human: approves non-routine answers before sending
Agent logs question type for monthly FAQ updates

opportunities.title: VAT returns pre-filled and checked before filing
opportunities.description: An agent gathers ledger data for each VAT period, prepares the return draft, and flags unusual input VAT claims. Your VAT specialist reviews and submits.
before: VAT specialist exports ledger data to Excel
Manual check of sales and purchase VAT codes
Build return in filing system
Check deadline list for missing clients
Submit return and save confirmation
after: Agent pulls ledger data for each client and period
Agent prepares VAT return draft with variance notes
Agent flags input VAT claims outside normal pattern
Human: reviews draft and approves filing
Agent files return and saves confirmation to client record

opportunities.title: Payroll changes collected and checked automatically
opportunities.description: An agent collects monthly employee changes by email, checks them against payroll records, and prepares a variance report for the payroll run. The payroll lead reviews before submission.
before: Payroll administrator asks clients for changes by email
Manually enters changes into payroll software
Calculates holiday pay and sick pay adjustments
Lead checks payroll report line by line
Files payroll taxes after approval
after: Agent requests and collects employee changes by email
Agent compares changes to payroll records and flags gaps
Agent prepares variance report for the monthly run
Human: reviews exceptions and approves payroll
Agent files payroll taxes and saves reports

opportunities.title: Year-end accounts compiled from standard checklists
opportunities.description: An agent compiles year-end figures into standard financial statements and checks disclosure requirements against a firm checklist. The review accountant handles judgement calls.
before: Preparer collects ledgers and prior year file
Reconciles accounts in Excel
Builds standard statements in Word or Excel
Checks disclosure checklist manually
Emails client for approval and waits
after: Agent gathers ledgers and prior year data
Agent reconciles accounts and flags mismatches
Agent drafts standard financial statements
Human: reviews judgement areas and disclosures
Agent sends approval request and tracks reply

opportunities.title: Month-end close status tracked without chasing the team
opportunities.description: An agent tracks close tasks, client document status, and review points in one dashboard. It sends daily task reminders to owners and flags clients at risk of late close.
before: Lead asks each bookkeeper for status
Updates Excel tracker manually
Checks deadlines in email and calendar
Sends reminders by email
Prepares status report for partner review
after: Agent reads task status from Exact, Twinfield and portal
Agent updates close dashboard each morning
Agent reminds task owners about due items
Agent flags clients at risk of late close
Human: reviews dashboard and resolves blockers

opportunities.title: New clients onboarded with clean data entry
opportunities.description: An agent collects ID and company details through a guided form, creates the client record in Exact or Twinfield, and sets up portal access. The specialist checks exceptions.
before: Onboarding specialist emails checklist to client
Client sends ID and company documents by email
Specialist types details into Exact or Twinfield
Requests portal account manually
Bookkeeper checks first transactions later
after: Agent sends guided onboarding form and tracks completion
Agent validates company details against documents
Agent creates client record in Exact or Twinfield
Agent sets up portal access and sends welcome email
Human: checks exceptions and approves first period

opportunities.title: Office invoices and leave requests handled by rules
opportunities.description: An agent logs supplier invoices, tracks leave requests, and prepares a weekly admin summary. The office manager approves payments and unusual requests.
before: Office manager opens supplier invoices by email
Enters invoice details into Excel tracker
Checks leave requests in email and calendar
Updates internal admin tracker
Prepares weekly summary for partner
after: Agent captures supplier invoices from email
Agent enters invoice details and flags duplicates
Agent logs leave requests and checks team calendar
Agent prepares weekly admin summary
Human: approves payments and unusual leave

roadmap.title: Prove three agents with one client group
items: Connect document chase agent to Exact, Twinfield and portal for 40 clients
Run bank coding agent in a review queue with two bookkeepers
Launch routine question agent with approved FAQ for portal questions
Measure accuracy, response rates, and hours returned each week
Hold a Friday review to fix exceptions before expanding

roadmap.title: Add VAT, payroll and annual accounts support
items: Add VAT return draft agent for a first group of clients
Add payroll change collection and variance agent
Add annual accounts compilation agent with disclosure checklist
Train named reviewers on exception handling for each agent
Report monthly hours saved and error rates to the partner team

roadmap.title: Scale across all clients and train the team
items: Roll out proven agents to all 400 clients in weekly batches
Add month-end status, onboarding, and office admin agents
Move staff from manual entry to review, advice, and client calls
Update procedures for agent audit logs and client consent
Review KPI targets and retire agents that do not return value

risks.risk: Client data confidentiality and GDPR compliance
risks.mitigation: Use EU hosting, strict access controls, data processing agreements, and human review before any client communication is sent.

risks.risk: Incorrect agent output causing filing errors
risks.mitigation: Keep human approval before VAT, payroll, and annual accounts submissions, with exception queues and audit logs for every change.
Use firm-branded messages, allow clients to request a human call, and escalate after two reminders.
Train champions in each team, show weekly time returned, and reassign people to review and advisory work.

risks.risk: Tool integration limits with Exact and Twinfield
risks.mitigation: Start with import and export plus portal APIs, test with a small client set, and keep manual fallback until accuracy is proven.
